431:t_2:17.en:
$$レド$$
「But... when I had to fight him, an inexplicable anxiety came over me...」

431:t_2:18.en:
$$レド$$
「That feeling... It was the same as when I defied Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$.」

431:t_2:19.en:
$$タケル$$
「Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$ was your superior in the $$人類銀河同盟$$, right, $$レド$$?」

431:t_2:20.en:
$$万丈$$
「The feeling of fighting someone like that... I think I understand.」

431:t_2:21.en:
$$桂$$
「Guilt, a sense of betrayal, self-denial... Strange emotions welled up from somewhere.」

431:t_2:22.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That feeling... As though we were the ones in the wrong...」

431:t_2:23.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Perhaps that is $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s power... Something like a $$スフィア・アクト$$.」

431:t_2:24.en:
$$バナージ$$
「A $$スフィア・アクト$$...」

431:t_2:25.en:
$$赤木$$
「Hey, $$クロウ$$... Is $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ a $$スフィア・リアクター$$ too?」

431:t_2:26.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We discussed that among ourselves, and we actually asked $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ about it.」

431:t_2:28.en:
$$ランド$$
「In the end, he dodged the question, so we didn't find out.」

431:t_2:29.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But we know for certain that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s machine uses $$次元力$$.」

431:t_2:30.en:
$$刹那$$
「That $$アスクレプス$$ was destroyed, though...」

431:t_2:31.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But he defeated $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ with his bare body.」

431:t_2:32.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「He was just like 《$$ガイオウ$$》!」

431:t_2:33.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「At the very least, he isn't human...」

431:t_2:34.en:
$$バナージ$$
「And he said he was $$テンシ$$.」

431:t_2:35.en:
$$赤木$$
「You mean he caused the $$時空震動$$ that killed $n's dad and sister!?」

431:t_2:36.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...We don't know. We don't know anything.」

431:t_2:37.en:
$$レド$$
「Will he target us from now on?」

431:t_2:38.en:
$$刹那$$
「We don't know. We don't even understand the actions of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists themselves.」

431:t_2:39.en:
$$赤木$$
「That sudden change of heart... Were they using us for their own ends, and now they don't need us anymore?」

431:t_2:40.en:
$$隼人$$
「I doubt it. If their enemy is $$サイデリアル$$, there's no advantage in cutting us off here.」

431:t_2:41.en:
$$隼人$$
「Their actions have no order... It's as though they're acting on a whim...」

431:t_2:42.en:
$$桂$$
「There really are too many things we don't understand. I'm at a loss.」

431:t_2:43.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Damn it... We've finally freed the $$翠の地球$$, and this is how we end up feeling...!」

431:t_2:45.en:
$$宗介$$
「He's asleep in the $$プトレマイオス$$'s infirmary.」

431:t_2:47.en:
$$甲児$$
「His training paid off. They say his injuries are a few bruises and cuts, and his life isn't in danger...」

431:t_2:48.en:
$$宗介$$
「But he still hasn't regained consciousness...」

431:t_2:50.en:
$$甲児$$
「The $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ he trusted turned out to be the $$テンシ$$ he was pursuing, and Nurse was with him too...」

431:t_2:51.en:
$$タケル$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$, $$ジェニオン$$... He's suffered one enormous shock after another...」

431:t_2:52.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But $n will be all right... won't he!?」

431:t_2:54.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$n has overcome so many obstacles before!」

431:t_2:55.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...We can't say anything for sure...」

431:t_2:56.en:
$$ランド$$
「All we can do is believe in $n.」

431:t_2:57.en:
$$万丈$$
「But we don't have time to wait for his recovery. We'll be heading for the $$蒼の地球$$ at once.」

431:t_2:58.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$オペレーション・エクリプス$$... Our full-scale counteroffensive against the $$新地球皇国$$ is beginning...」

431:t_2:59.en:
$$甲児$$
($n... Is this where it ends for you...?)

431:t_2:60.en:
$$宗介$$
(We've found your enemy, $$テンシ$$. Now all you have to do is fight...)

431:t_2:66.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...We now have a plan for repairing $$ジェニオン$$.」

431:t_2:67.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now we only need to wait for you to wake up, $n. Please wake up.」

431:t_2:70.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then I shall take action in accordance with our contract.」

431:t_10:4.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Welcome. As the proprietor, $$ＡＧ$$, is absent today, $$Ｄトレーダー$$ will operate through our unattended service.」

431:t_10:5.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Please understand that congratulations for ace pilots will be deferred to another occasion.」

431:t_10:6.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Now, everyone, please take your time and enjoy your shopping.」

432:t_000:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「The $$セントラル・ベース$$ assault force has sortied.」

432:t_000:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We've somehow made it this far.」

432:t_000:2.en:
$$メラン$$
「The enemy interception force is coming!」

432:t_001:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, to be honest, I hadn't intended to use these forces.」

432:t_001:2.en:
$$カトル$$
「It's true we faced one hard battle after another breaking through your defensive lines to reach this base.」

432:t_001:3.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Thanks to all those traps you prepared.」

432:t_001:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Goodness... I never expected you to break through every one of them.」

432:t_001:5.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Attacks by mind-controlled resistance fighters... Human shields made of captured civilians...」

432:t_001:6.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Hallucination attacks that trigger our trauma, and assassination squads sent to our camps...」

432:t_001:7.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Every last one was a vile tactic that made me sick!」

432:t_001:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「There's no such thing as fair or foul in war. That's... common knowledge across the galaxy.」

432:t_001:9.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I have no intention of debating tactics with you.」

432:t_001:10.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Of course. I feel the same way.」

432:t_001:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If I dawdle too much, I'll end up like $$ギルター$$.」

432:t_001:12.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hey, old man! Where's Sis $$セツコ$$!?」

432:t_001:13.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Don't worry. $$セツコ$$ is in that base.」

432:t_001:14.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Our boss is keeping her very, very carefully in storage.」

432:t_001:16.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't let him get to you, $$シン$$! Winding us up like that is that bastard's specialty!」

432:t_001:17.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It's rather difficult to work when there are familiar faces around.」

432:t_001:18.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Let's end this farce, $$サルディアス$$. Underneath it all, you're just like $$バルビエル$$. You think human lives are worth no more than insects.」

432:t_001:19.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I won't deny it.」

432:t_001:20.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Though I do know the saying, 'Even the smallest insect has a soul.'」

432:t_001:21.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We don't need to hold back against someone like that!」

uncertain: 431:t_2:20: Fighting that person refers to a superior; rendered someone like that.
432:t_001:8: Japanese foul/onion rhyme localized as fair or foul while retaining dismissal of wartime ethics.
